privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Ki Banawat
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Transparent, local-first aur ekdam secure.
privacyPolicy.manifestoTitle: Manifesto: Aapka data hamara product NAHI hai.
privacyPolicy.manifestoText: YT Deluxe ko invisible banne ke liye engineer kiya gaya hai.
privacyPolicy.q1Title: Hum kaun sa data jama karte hain?
privacyPolicy.q1Text: Hum sirf wahi data jama karte hain jo zaruri hai: YouTube URLs, quality preferences aur download history (agar aap chahein).
privacyPolicy.q2Title: Hum ise kyun jama karte hain?
privacyPolicy.q2Text: Sirf aapke downloads manage karne ke liye.
privacyPolicy.prefsLanguageDetail: Sirf aapke device par store hoti hai
privacyPolicy.themeDisplayDetail: Sessions ke beech bani rehti hai, kabhi upload nahi hoti
privacyPolicy.q3Text: Aapka data aapke paas hi rehta hai. Browser mein localStorage aur Windows par local JSON file.
privacyPolicy.ytGoogleDesc: Unki Privacy Policy aur Terms of Service unke platform ke sath sabhi interactions par laagu hoti hai.
privacyPolicy.noServicesDesc: Koi analytics providers, ad networks, ya data brokers koi bhi information nahi paate.
privacyPolicy.firstPrinciple: Hum Sovereignty First rules par kaam karte hain. Meta-data aur storage aapka hai.
privacyPolicy.zeroExfiltrationDesc: Browser history sirf localStorage mein rehti hai. Ye kabhi bhi hamare servers ko nahi chhutti.
privacyPolicy.localFilesDesc: Desktop users ko apni home directory mein download_history.json ki poori visibility milti hai. Ise kabhi bhi delete karein.
privacyPolicy.noAnalyticsDesc: Koi tracking pixels, cookies, heatmaps, ya crash reporters use nahi hote. Kabhi nahi.
privacyPolicy.ephemeral: Web version par, media files ek temporary server folder mein process hoti hain aur 10 minutes baad automatically delete ho jaati hain.

aboutUs.heroSubtitle: ★ Hinglish Mode Active ★ - Sabse Premium Media Downloader
aboutUs.aboutText1: YT Deluxe ek free, open-source, full-stack media management application hai jo aapko YouTube videos aur audio search, preview, aur download karne deta hai - ek premium Liquid Glass UI ke saath.
aboutUs.aboutText2: Zyaadatar downloaders ads, malware, aur paywalls se bhare hain. YT Deluxe inhe sab theek karne ke liye bana hai: 100% ad-free, self-hosted, koi trackers nahi, 144p se 8K tak support.
aboutUs.futureText1: YT Deluxe lagatar evolve ho raha hai. Hamare roadmap mein playlist batch downloading, subtitle embedding, aur native progress notifications shamil hain.
aboutUs.futureText2: Hum download history ke liye cloud sync, mobile PWA support, aur custom post-processors ke liye plugin system bhi explore kar rahe hain.
aboutUs.premiumEdge: YT Deluxe Kya Kar Sakta Hai
aboutUs.feat1Desc: Keyword se YouTube search karein ya direct URL paste karein. Thumbnails, duration, view count ke saath rich video cards browse karein.
aboutUs.feat2Desc: 144p se lekar 8K tak download karein. MP4, MKV, WebM, M4A, Opus aur MP3 ke saath FFmpeg merging support.
aboutUs.feat3Desc: Live preview ke saath frame-accurate start aur end point chunein. Sirf zaruri segment download karein.
aboutUs.feat4Desc: Exact codec streams, container formats aur audio bitrates chunein. Poora control aapke haath mein.
aboutUs.feat5Desc: Kisi bhi browser mein web app ya native Windows desktop application ke roop mein seamlessly chalta hai.
aboutUs.feat6Desc: Koi tracking nahi, koi telemetry nahi, koi account nahi. Sab kuch aapke device par rehta hai.
aboutUs.feat7Desc: English, Hindi, German aur Hinglish mein available, full i18n support ke saath.
aboutUs.feat8Desc: Apne saare downloads track, filter aur manage karein. Bulk delete, storage monitor aur re-download support.
aboutUs.devRole: Full Stack Artisan aur System Engineer
aboutUs.devDesc: High-performance aur dikhne mein lajawab systems banane ka junoon. YT Deluxe technical robustness aur premium 'Liquid Glass' design ka ek perfect fusion hai.
aboutUs.footerBanner: Free & Open Source - GPL-3.0 - Non-Commercial Intent
aboutUs.footerText: 2026 YT Deluxe. Utsav Parmar ne banaya. React aur yt-dlp ke saath.

termsCond.heroSubtitle: Legal framework taki sab sahi rahe.
termsCond.g1Desc: YT Deluxe free aur open source hai.
termsCond.g2Desc: Hum YouTube guidelines ka poora samman karte hain.
termsCond.g3Desc: Ye platform sirf educational aur research use ke liye hai.
termsCond.mutualAgreementDesc: YT Deluxe download, install ya use karke, aap in sharton se sahamat hote hain. Agar sahamat nahi, toh use mat karein. Kisi bhi update ke baad lagaataar use nai sharton ki manzuri hai.
termsCond.updatesToTermsDesc: Hum in sharton ko kabhi bhi modify karne ka adhikar rakhte hain. Kisi bhi badlaav ke baad YT Deluxe ka lagaataar use nai sharton ki aapki manzuri darshata hai.
termsCond.nonCommercialDesc: Strictly personal, non-commercial use ke liye. Aap is software ko bech nahi sakte, users se charge nahi le sakte, ya ads/subscriptions ke zariye monetize nahi kar sakte.
termsCond.respectCreatorsDesc: Aap poori tarah zimmedar hain ki aapke dwara download ki gayi content copyright law ka palan karti hai. Is tool ka use piracy ke liye mat karein.
termsCond.disclaimerText1: YT Deluxe YouTube ya Google LLC se affiliated, endorsed ya sponsored nahi hai. Sabhi YouTube trademarks unke respective owners ki property hain.
termsCond.disclaimerText2: Software 'jaisa hai' bina kisi warranty ke diya gaya hai. Developers YouTube sahit third-party services ke saath technical interactions se utpann kisi bhi nuksan ke liye uttardayi nahi hain.
